name: Venue request

Thanks for getting in touch. We act on every venue request, and remove a venue's listings within 7 days.
See https://musenmingle.interstellarai.net/about#for-venues for what we show and how we collect it.

**Venue / site:** <name and website>

**What would you like us to do?** (tick one or more)

- [ ] Stop listing our events altogether
- [ ] Stop using our images (we'll keep the facts and a link)
- [ ] Stop showing our descriptions (we'll keep the facts and a link)
- [ ] Correct something (wrong dates, venue, price, …)
- [ ] Something else

**Details** (which events or pages, what's wrong, anything else we should know):

**How can we confirm you speak for the venue?** (optional, e.g. reply from an address on the venue's domain once we have an email contact)
